company_summary: Sandbridge builds agent-facing UI overlays and orchestration for large contact centers. Evaluating a low-latency inference partner to replace current provider for real-time suggestion and tool-calling. They prioritize predictable latency under spikes, guardrail reliability, and deployment into customer VPCs / selective on-prem nodes.
requirements_summary: Workload: streaming agent assist + quick ticket summarization post-call
Latency SLOs: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 250ms for suggestion tokens (end-to-end from audio->suggestion) — strict for UI UX
Throughput: support up to 1,500 concurrent agents across regions; peak bursts ~2k reqs/s for short windows
Availability: failover to lightweight fallback model with graceful degradation; can tolerate brief token truncation but not complete blackout
Guardrails: deterministic tool-calling policy, entity redaction for PII, live hallucination detection + human-in-the-loop override
Model preferences: open-model variants acceptable; require quantized variants for Dedicated GPUs and deterministic fallbacks for Private deployments
Observability: token-level cost & latency, replay traces per suggestion, regression alerts tied to prompt test-suite
